mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above the 5-year moving average coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its 5-week simple moving average
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, 20-day forward returns remain non-negative during high-rate regimes, or the 5-week SMA crossing is not followed by negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a decline in hourly wage growth (indirect proxy via HOUST) signals weakening labor market strength, which precedes a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises for 3 consecutive months while HOUST falls by at least 2% from its prior month
failure_condition: Over 200 observations, no statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05) when the defined labor weakening pattern occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeding 2% above its prior month's rate predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals robust economic momentum.
failure_condition: Across 500+ test windows, no significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO accelerates by >2%.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for two months followed by a rebound above 2% triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates disinflation and rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2.0 for two consecutive months then CPIAUCSL > 2.0 in the following month
failure_condition: In 1000+ test windows, no statistically significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05) when the disinflation pattern is detected.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5% for three consecutive months while the 10-year Treasury yield rises (indirect via FEDFUNDS), it suggests a shift to accommodative policy, producing a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5 for 3 months and FEDFUNDS rises by >0.05% over the same period
failure_condition: Over 400 test windows, no significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05) when both conditions hold.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in retail employment (PAYEMS) by at least 10,000 jobs in a single month coincides with a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as the market anticipates over-hiring risks.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥10,000 in a single month
failure_condition: Across 700 test windows, no negative return (t-test p > 0.05) when the threshold is triggered.

mechanism_narrative: A two consecutive months of declining retail sales (indirect via HOUST proxy) followed by a rebound above the prior month's level predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market expects stabilization in demand.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls for two consecutive months then HOUST rebounds above prior month's value
failure_condition: Over 900 test windows, no significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05) when the supply-demand pattern is detected.

mechanism_narrative: During a prolonged period of declining consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2.5% without a corresponding rise in industrial production (INDPRO), a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return is expected as the market anticipates a terminal rate path.
failure_condition: Across 400 test windows, no significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05) when both CPIAUCSL < 2.5% and INDPRO flat or declining.
